blocks.text: If your SI/SC letter places you in the PATH program, have your treating clinician complete Section 1, then bring this signed page and all interim detailed clinical progress notes (DCPN) to your AME for review and upload them into your FAA file.

blocks.text: Section 1. Treating clinician. Please answer questions 1 and 2, sign, and return this form to the patient or their Aviation Medical Examiner (AME). See the DCPN criteria, as a letter to the FAA may not contain all the needed information.

blocks.text: Your patient should self-report and abstain from safety-related duties (pilot/ATCS) when they have a medical deficiency (e.g., worsening of condition, symptoms, etc). However, if your patient experiences a significant clinical deterioration in cognition, judgment, emotional stability, or insight and lacks the awareness to ground themselves, please notify the FAA Aeromedical Certification Division (405-954-4821) or their AME.
